description: This file defines the interface for a timer management library in C, including function declarations, type definitions, and macros related to timer operations such as creation, destruction, insertion, updating, removal, and retrieval of scheduled timers.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new timer object with specified quantity, threading model, and thread ID check configuration.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a timer object and releases associated resources.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_insert
methods.description: Inserts a new timer with a specified timeout, handler, and data, returning a timer ID.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_update
methods.description: Updates the timeout for an existing timer identified by timer ID.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_update_handler
methods.description: Updates the timeout, handler, and data for an existing timer.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_remove
methods.description: Removes a timer identified by timer ID from the timer object.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_next_get
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled timer's ID, timeout, handler, and data based on the current time.

methods.name: rdkx_timer_next_get_ts
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled timer's information using a timespec structure.
